description: Inspect one equipment model in the DualSoft Public 3D Library by id (equivalent aliases: assetId, modelId, model_id, slug; id takes precedence), returning dimensions, units, joints, semantic ports, usage rights, SHA-256 download links, and optional verified .ds2 source (DISPLAY_PREVIEW, keyless). Omitting id returns the default starter asset 'b01-01-belt-conveyor' with fallback=true; set view='summary' for compact <10KB metadata, 'kinematics' for joint bindings, or 'full' (default) for complete node/binding trees, and includeDs2Source=true (alias: includeDs2) for source text. Use after dsdx.library.search to inspect a chosen model; use dsdx.library.search to browse or filter equipment.

asset_type_id.description: Snake_case alias for id (matches search result asset_type_id)

id.description: Approved 3D library model ID (e.g. 'a01-01-six-axis-robot', 'b01-01-belt-conveyor'; optional: omitting returns starter asset 'b01-01-belt-conveyor' with fallback=true; call dsdx.library.search to browse all approved IDs)

includeDs2Source.description: Whether to include verified .ds2 (DSLText) source inline in ds2Source (default: true for 'full', false for 'summary'/'kinematics')

view.description: Response detail level: 'summary' (compact <10KB bounds, joints, ports, links; recommended for multi-asset layout planning) | 'kinematics' (adds initialState & jointBindings) | 'full' (default on dsdx.library.get; includes complete scene nodes & frames)

name: dsdx.library.get

error.description: Structured error payload when status != OK
